navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Saginaw River
navaid.description: U.S. Coast Guard Station Saginaw River's missions include Search and Rescue, Law Enforcement, Homeland Security, Ice Rescue, Military Readiness, and Environmental Response. Area of responsibility includes Saginaw Bay and Saginaw River.

features.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Harbor Beach

navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Harbor Beach
navaid.description: Operating seasonally, Coast Guard Station Harbor Beach's missions include Search and Rescue, Maritime Law Enforcement, Ice Rescue, and Recreational Boating Safety. Area of responsibility is from Wild Fowl Point, to Port Sanilac.
